newsitem.title: USA: MHM Services files suit against MEDIQ.
newsitem.headline: MHM Services files suit against MEDIQ.

text.p: MHM Services Inc said on Monday it filed a suit in the Essex County (N.J.) Superior Court against MEDIQ Inc to void a five year $11.5 million note and to recover $4.5 million already paid under the not and damages.
MEDIQ required MHM to sign a note in connection with the spin-off of MHM on August 31, 1993, MHM said.
MEDIQ was not immediately available for comment.

MHM alleges in its lawsuit that it received no consideration for the note, that MEDIQ breached its obligations to MHM in forcing MHM to execute the note and that the note unjustly enriches MEDIQ at MHM's expense.
The note represents part of some $21 million of payment obligations MEDIQ sought to impose on MHM from 1986 through 1993, while MHM was a subsidiary of MEDIQ, the company said.
In an unrelated matter, MHM said it has received a contract to provide dental services to the Delaware State Prison System. The contact is worth $425,000 a year.
